newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai Ind seen seeking $200 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Ind seen seeking $200 mln loan.

text.p: HONG KONG, March 4 (Reuter) Shanghai Industrial Holdings is expected to seek financing via a US$200 million loan facility, bankers said Tuesday.
The company is the overseas investment arm of the Shanghai municipal government. Bankers said the loan facility is expected to have a final maturity of five years.
A spokesman at Shanghai Industrial Holdings said the company is considering various forms of funding but has not yet made any decisions on the amount to be raised or the instruments to be used.

Shanghai Industrial Investment Holdings, which wholly owns Shanghai Investment Holdings which in turn holds 65.1 percent of Shanghai Industrial Holdings, completed a five-year US$80 million club loan earlier this year.
